# Music Player 0.4.6-rc.1

This is a prerelease for trying the new account-bound Emby audio and source
extension paths. It is not a declaration that long-form playback is production
validated. The existing v0.4.5 release and image tags remain unchanged.

## Included

- Native Emby accounts, including explicit empty-password updates and stable
  account identity across edits, queues and saved source references.
- Paginated media-library navigation for audio and audio-bearing video entries,
  including movies, episodes and music videos, without rendering video.
- Per-occurrence media-version/audio-track selection, pinned choices for
  supported seek/resume paths, and account-bound queue operations.
- Cancellable streaming transport and generation-aware playback with bounded
  reader/output cancellation and conservative unconfirmed-end handling.
- Web media browsing and audio selection, native desktop media browsing, and
  corresponding GraphQL/gRPC interfaces.
- WASM source extension v1/v2 account/runtime support, Web source-account
  management/browsing, shared daemon APIs, and explicit incompatible-operation
  errors instead of silently falling back from v2 to v1.
- Linux CLI packages and a Debian 13 slim container for amd64 and arm64.

## Known Limits

- Desktop management/browsing of extension source accounts is deferred. The
  existing desktop extension list/enable/rescan and native media browser are
  separate from that missing entry point. Use the Web/API extension-account
  interfaces for this candidate.
- Real Emby full-length playback, non-aligned long seeks, physical sound-device
  behavior and correlated server-transcoder cleanup have not completed their
  acceptance matrix. Synthetic HTTP/WASM/PCM and packaging CI are not substitutes.
- FIFO/TCP byte delivery is not proof that a listener or device consumed audio.
  Missing completion evidence remains an unconfirmed end, not automatic proof
  that the whole program completed.
- Video display, subtitles, playback-rate control and chapters are not included.

## Try The Container

Once the release's publishing workflow has completed, use the explicit version:

```text
ghcr.io/killbus/music-player:0.4.6-rc.1
```

There is no `latest` image alias. Prefer the published digest for a pinned trial.
The image runs as UID/GID 10001, persists application state under `/data`, and
exposes Web UI/HTTP on 5053, gRPC on 5051 and WebSocket on 5052. Configure output
and shared FIFO permissions as described in `dist/README.md` and
`dist/compose.snapcast.yml`; the image does not include a Snapserver.

## Upgrade And Rollback

Back up the entire application data/configuration directory before first start,
or use a disposable copy for this prerelease. This version adds account/source
database migrations. Merely reverting to an old executable or image does not
establish database compatibility; retain the pre-upgrade backup for rollback.
Never run two versions concurrently against the same writable SQLite/data tree.

Verify each download with its adjacent `.sha256`. CLI-only packages conflict
with the combined desktop package; do not install both package variants together.
Ubuntu 24.04 DEB and Fedora 44 RPM checks do not establish support for every
Linux distribution. Archive downloads still need their native runtime libraries.

Debian and RPM package metadata use `0.4.6~rc.1` so this prerelease sorts before
the eventual `0.4.6` final. The application version, release tag and image tag
retain the SemVer spelling `0.4.6-rc.1`. Build metadata/checksum assets identify
the actual release source; publication workflows must finish before all platform
downloads and the multi-architecture image are available.
